settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceLocaleCaption: DimRead is currently available in English only.
settings.appearanceReducedMotionCaption: Force-reduce animations regardless of the OS preference.
settings.generalMinimizeToTrayCaption: Closing the DimRead window hides it to the tray instead of quitting.
settings.saveBeforeCloseFailed: Couldn't save settings, so the window stayed open: {reason}
settings.aboutTooltip: App identity, startup, backups, diagnostics, logs, and reset tools.
settings.aboutStartOnLoginCaption: Launch DimRead automatically when you sign in.
settings.aboutAnonymousReportsCaption: Allow privacy-scrubbed crash and operational diagnostics when a reporting service is configured. Off by default.
settings.aboutSettingsExportSummary: Save a readable, versioned JSON backup of every DimRead setting.
settings.aboutSettingsImportSummary: Restore a compatible settings backup and apply it immediately.
settings.aboutSettingsImportConfirmDescription: The imported backup will replace every current DimRead setting on this device.
settings.aboutOpenLogsSummary: Open the portable-aware folder containing DimRead's rolling log files.
settings.aboutSaveBundleSummary: Create a ZIP containing local logs, system information, and recent operational issues.
settings.aboutLiveLogsDescription: Streaming is off until started and stops when you leave this page. Existing diagnostic records only; file names may appear.
settings.aboutLiveLogsEmpty: Start streaming to see new diagnostic lines.
settings.aboutIssuesDescription: Latest native failures captured locally for troubleshooting.
settings.aboutResetSummary: Restore every setting to its default. Logs and other app files remain in place.
settings.aboutResetConfirmDescription: Every DimRead setting will be restored to its default value. Logs and app files are not removed.
settings.aboutUpdatesCaption: DimRead only contacts GitHub while you are on this screen and press the button.
settings.aboutUpdateChecking: Checking GitHub for a newer release…
settings.aboutUpdateUpToDate: You are on the latest release ({version}).
settings.aboutUpdateAhead: This build ({current}) is newer than the latest release ({latest}).
settings.aboutUpdateUnavailable: Update checks are only available in the desktop app.
settings.aboutCreditsBody: DimRead is open source under the MIT licence — no account or activation, and anonymous reporting is opt-in. It is built on Tauri v2 and React 19, and its design system, multi-window shell and download manager were extracted from WinSTT.
settings.hotkeysTooltip: Every global shortcut: brightness, colour temperature, the app window, Focus Read/Blur and MagicX.
settings.displayTooltip: Colour temperature, brightness and preset modes, and how the filter is applied.

displayTab.title: Display
displayTab.subtitle: Tune blue-light filtering, brightness and colour temperature.
displayTab.locationMethodCaption: Pick the timezone you are in, or enter exact coordinates.
displayTab.timezoneCaption: Sun times are computed for this timezone's city.
displayTab.timezonePlaceholder: Search for a city or timezone
displayTab.detectedFailed: Your system timezone could not be read. Pick one below, or enter coordinates.
displayTab.unresolvedTimezone: {timezone} has no known city. Pick another timezone, or enter coordinates.
displayTab.locationLoadFailed: Location and sun times could not be loaded.
displayTab.sunTimesPolar: Today the sun does not rise or set at this location.
displayTab.scheduleSameDay: Day runs from sunrise to sunset.
displayTab.scheduleOvernight: Sunrise is later than sunset, so the day period continues through midnight.
displayTab.scheduleEqual: Matching sunrise and sunset means the schedule stays in night mode all day.
displayTab.phaseTransitionHelper: Fading between day and night — the screen is between the two profiles, so these sliders set the profile shown above rather than the exact level on screen.
displayTab.modePauseDesc: Filtering off — true colours at full brightness.
displayTab.modeHealthDesc: Balanced blue-light reduction for everyday work.
displayTab.modeGameDesc: Light filtering that keeps games crisp and responsive.
displayTab.modeMovieDesc: Warmer, dimmer tone tuned for watching video.
displayTab.modeOfficeDesc: Comfortable warmth for long hours of office work.
displayTab.modeEditingDesc: Inverts screen colours for low-light reading and editing.
displayTab.modeReadingDesc: Full-screen grayscale, like e-ink, for distraction-free reading.
displayTab.modeReadingGrayscaleUnavailable: Reading temperature and brightness are active, but full-screen grayscale is unavailable on this display backend.
displayTab.modeCustomDesc: Your own colour temperature and brightness.
displayTab.timeSourceCaption: Detect your location, set it yourself, or use fixed hours.
displayTab.transitionCaption: How long the fade between day and night takes.

optionsTab.title: Options
optionsTab.subtitle: Configure how DimRead behaves.
optionsTab.smoothTransitionCaption: Animate colour and brightness changes instead of snapping between values.
optionsTab.wideRangeCaption: Extend the temperature range to 1000-10000 K (default 1000-6500 K).
optionsTab.wideRangeWarning: Temperatures above 6500 K increase blue-light exposure and are not recommended.
optionsTab.brightnessWideRangeCaption: Extend the brightness range down to 0% (default floor 10%).
optionsTab.brightnessWideRangeWarning: 0% brightness dims the screen to fully black, which can make it hard to see.
optionsTab.fullscreenDetectionCaption: Turn the filter off automatically while a full-screen app or game is in the foreground.
optionsTab.hotkeysCaption: Click record on a row, then press a key combination. Function keys and modifier combos are supported.

rulesTab.title: Rules
rulesTab.subtitle: Switch modes automatically when a chosen app is in the foreground.
rulesTab.empty: No rules yet. Add one to switch modes per app.
rulesTab.finderToolCaption: Pick an open app to fill in the pattern below.
rulesTab.builtInCaption: Always active — it needs no rule of its own.

focusTab.title: Focus
focusTab.subtitle: Highlight what you are reading and dim the rest
focusTab.readCaption: A clear band follows your cursor while the rest of the screen is dimmed.
focusTab.blurCaption: Dim every background window so the active one stands out.
focusTab.adminHint: Windows from apps running as administrator can't be detected, so they won't be highlighted.

magicxTab.title: MagicX
magicxTab.subtitle: Per-window dark mode and automatic theme switching
magicxTab.magicWindowCaption: Apply a dark (invert) or grayscale effect to any single window.
magicxTab.toolbarCaption: When enabled, hovering the top of a window shows the Magic Toolbar; otherwise these effects are only available via hotkeys.
magicxTab.autoDarkCaption: Schedule the Windows system theme. This does not change DimRead itself.
magicxTab.themeNote: Some apps don't follow the Windows theme setting.
magicxTab.followDayNightCaption: Use the sunrise and sunset above, so the theme turns over with the filter. Turn off to set separate times.
